title: fix(platform-objects): Setup → Users opens on the All Users list view
body:
Fixes #21960
Clause-②: no

## What changes

Setup → Users now opens on the **All Users** list view (`all_users`). Before this, it opened **My Profile** (`me`): one row, the administrator, with a page size of 1.

- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts`: `nav_users` gains `viewName: 'all_users'`. That key is the one `ObjectNavItemSchema` already declares on an object navigation item ("Default list view to open"). No new key.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`: a comment only. The `me` view's comment said the Account App surfaces it. At `main` it does not (see the readers below), and the comment now names what does reach it.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-users-nav-view.test.ts`: the pins.
- `.changeset/21960-setup-users-all-users.md`: `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch.

⛔ No `listViews` reorder, no view removed, no `packages/spec` edit, no governed surface.

Implemented by the os-dev run of session `session_017ErfyP2Rx7XWHJA27QjyUi` on branch `claude/issue-21960-setup-users-all-users`.

## The console honours `viewName` (measured, H1)

Read in objectui at the commit `.objectui-sha` pins, `0abd4f9f8769fc4c19ad2f96707684876f74c09f`:

- `packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx`, `resolveHref`, case `object`. The precedence is `recordId`, then `filters`, then `viewName`. With `viewName` the href is `OBJECT/view/VIEWNAME`; without it, the bare `OBJECT` path.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`. The active view is the URL view id, then `?view=`, then a view marked `isDefault`, then `views[0]`. Only the object's primary `list` is marked `isDefault` (`buildViewTabs`), and `sys_user` declares none, so `views[0]` is the first declared list view: `me`. That is what the card observed.
- `packages/core/src/utils/resolve-view-id.ts` matches the short name `all_users` against the qualified id `sys_user.all_users`.
- "Defaults to "all"" in the spec's `viewName` describe does not hold for an object that declares list views. `all` is only the id of the fallback tab the console builds for an object with no list views. This is reported on the card; it is not edited here, because it is spec text.

The served path keeps the key as authored. `applyNavContributions` (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`) pushes contributed items into a structured clone of the app, and `filterNav` (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`) pushes a passing leaf item unchanged. `nav_notifications` already ships `viewName: 'recent'` through the same contribution path.

## Who reads `me` (measured, H2)

- **Navigation items: none.** The Account app's profile entry is `nav_account_profile`: `type: 'component'`, `componentRef: 'account:profile_card'`. No Account entry routes to `sys_user`.
- **objectui at the pin: none by name.** `account:profile_card` is registered in `apps/console/src/registerAccountComponents.tsx` and renders `ProfilePage`, which reads the signed-in user from `useAuth()` and writes through `updateUser`.
- **Pages: none.** `pages/sys-user.page.ts` names no list view.
- **Tests: none.**
- **Other references:** the four generated translation bundles carry the tab's label, and the spec's `ObjectNavItemSchema` docblock cites `sys_user.me` as an example of the `{current_user_id}` filter vocabulary.

So `me` is reached only as a tab, and as the default tab when a route names no view. Triage's second pin ("the Account app's My Profile still opens on the caller's own row") is held by the profile component, and it is pinned there.

## Pins

`setup-users-nav-view.test.ts`, 7 cases:

- `nav_users` sits in `group_people_org` with `type: 'object'`, `objectName: 'sys_user'` and `viewName: 'all_users'`;
- it carries neither `recordId` nor `filters`, both of which `resolveHref` honours ahead of `viewName`;
- `sys_user.listViews.all_users` exists under that same name;
- that view is not scoped to the caller: no `filter`, no `{current_user_id}` anywhere in it, and a page size above 1;
- the contribution passes a full `NavigationContributionSchema.safeParse`, and the parsed item keeps `viewName: 'all_users'`;
- the Account app's first entry is `nav_account_profile`, the `account:profile_card` component;
- no Account entry routes to `sys_user`.

**No dogfood door pin.** The framework half of the door is the served Setup nav, and both sites on that path pass the item through as authored (above). The data half is unchanged by this diff: `all_users` carries no filter. A door case would assert what the metadata pin already holds.

## Reverse verification

On committed `6639eb4a52`:

```text
node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts \
  --anchor "viewName: 'all_users', " --delete -- \
  pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/apps/setup-users-nav-view.test.ts
```

- **Mutation landed:** anchor 1 → 0, blob `72a3adcc1066` → `7c70ade946a9`.
- **Result: 4 failed | 3 passed (7).** The four cases that read `nav_users.viewName` went red. The `recordId` / `filters` case and both Account cases stayed green, as expected, because none of them reads `viewName`.
- **Restored:** the blob after restore, `72a3adcc1066`, equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. `git status --porcelain` was empty afterwards.
- **Resolution path:** the test imports its subject by relative path from `src/`, not through the package `exports`, so no `dist/` sits between the mutation and the run.
- **First attempt:** it was refused by the tool before anything ran, because its replacement text already appeared inside the anchor. It ran nothing and restored.

  - The `--ran` reconciliation reads `63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. That is a derived zero: every line carried its exit code.

  - `check:type-check-debt` first hit the runner's 420 s cap while it refreshed its closure. The rerun exited 0, with "1 ledger entr(ies) re-measured ... none above its recorded number".

  - The population is read from `eslint.config.mjs`: its `packages/**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts}` blocks match all three, and none was reported as ignored.
  - The count comes from `--format json`.
  - The config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
  - The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **Other doors still open on `me`.** objectui's `AppHeader` links the object breadcrumb segment and the object switcher to the bare object path, and a bare path opens `views[0]`. So from a user's record page, the "Users" breadcrumb still lands on My Profile. This PR closes the Setup nav door, as dispatched. Changing which view `sys_user` opens by default is the declaration-order route, which the dispatch reserved. It is reported on the card.
- **Sidebar highlight.** objectui's `resolveActiveNavItem` scores a `viewName` item only on its own view. So `nav_users` no longer lights up on a user's record page or on the other tabs, where the bare item used to claim every `sys_user` sub-route. Every `viewName` entry behaves this way today (`nav_notifications`, and the Account `mine` entries). This was read from source at the pin, not measured in a browser.
- **Six other Setup entries land an admin on a caller-scoped first view.** `nav_api_keys`, `nav_sessions`, `nav_oauth_apps`, `nav_accounts` and `nav_user_preferences` each open a `mine` view first, and plugin-sharing's `nav_record_shares` opens `granted_to_me` first. Their page sizes are 50 to 100, so these are not one-row views. They are reported on the card, not fixed here.
